Within the combinatory matrix of the Paṭṭhāna's conditional relations, the text treats the analytical pairings of the influxes and things associated with influxes (*āsavasāsavadukādi*) mapped across the triad of states endowed with visibility (*sanidassanattika*) [SuttaCentral].
